sources.note: Main homepage. Lists MedicsCloud EHR, MedicsPremier PM, MedicsRIS, and RCM services. Describes target market as medical practices, imaging centers, labs, behavioral health, rural hospitals.
Company history: founded 1977 by David Barzillai, 300+ employees, privately owned, never acquired/merged. Based in Paramus, NJ. Debt-free, handles all development internally.
ONC mandatory disclosures for MedicsCloud v11.0. Lists certification criteria, 25 CQMs, cost structure, and additional software components (Surescripts eRx, Direct Messaging).
EHR product page. Describes AI-powered documentation (MedicsScribe), e-prescribing, lab integration, voice navigation, FHIR/HL7 compatibility, patient portal, telemedicine, MIPS reporting.
Product suite overview. Describes MedicsPremier (PM), MedicsCloud EHR, MedicsRIS, MedicsRCM, and the integrated Medics Suite combining EHR+PM.

Comprehensive feature list. Includes patient portal, kiosk, texting, telemedicine, RPM, claim tracking, denial manager, insurance verification/discovery, patient due estimator, inventory management, attorney management, bed management, CRM, MIPS reporting, analytics.

Patient-facing features: MedicsKiosk (digital check-in with e-signatures, ID scanning), telemedicine (no app required), interactive texting, RPM (blood pressure, glucose, O2 sat), MedicsMobile app, patient portal.
TechRadar review: 3/5 stars. Praised patient portal and support options. Criticized opaque pricing, no free trial, mobile app issues.
Capterra listing for MedicsCloud EHR. Mixed reviews — praised responsive support and value, noted disjointed onboarding between billing and EHR staff. (Page returned 403, used search snippet.)
SoftwareFinder listing with demo, reviews, features, and pricing info for MedicsCloud.
2021 press release announcing ezCDS clinical decision support integration with MedicsCloud EHR.
Company timeline: founded 1977 in NYC apartment, grew to 500 clients in 1980s, then 1000+ clients, expanded to 15,000 sq ft building with 200+ employees.
